summary: Validated the new Login/Register split for CoinQuest. Backend regression (5/5 passed): /api/auth/login now returns 404 for unknown identifiers, 401 for wrong password on an existing account, and 200 + session_token for valid creds; /api/auth/school-login still works. Frontend validated end-to-end on desktop 1920x900 and mobile 390x844: site header shows Login + Register on / and workshop pages, only Enquire Now on /for-schools; hero has register+login CTAs; /register renders 3 steps, go-to-login link and the full PricingSection with working Buy Now -> checkout dialog (empty-field validation shows 'Please fill in all fields'); /signup correctly redirects to /register; /login page has NO signup fields (no name/phone/confirm-password/captcha); unknown identifier shows the no-account-alert with Register-now button that routes to /register; wrong password shows 'Invalid email/username or password' toast and does NOT show the no-account-alert; all four role logins (parent, admin, teacher, school) land on their correct dashboards.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthPage.jsx: in no-account branch the toast is intentionally suppressed in favor of the inline alert — good UX. Consider also clearing noAccount when the identifier is edited (already done in onChange) ✓.
RegisterPage.jsx is clean and reuses PricingSection — no duplication.
SiteHeader.jsx correctly scopes the Login/Register split behind !isSchoolsPage; data-testids are consistent with the spec.

backend/routes/auth.py unified_login does a lowercase match on email but checks username case-sensitively — acceptable, matches rest of codebase. Pre-check uses projection {_id:1} so Mongo _id is not serialized.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login/Register split is fully working as of iter 127. test_auth_login_states.py pins the 404/401/200 contract — reuse it as regression. Checkout flow was validated up to the dialog + empty-field error only (per instructions, no real Razorpay payment was completed).
